detail: Live slot equalled 'now'. Built an exact copy of creative 120203212129110598 (page/IG ids, link_data image_hash + CTA SIGN_UP, degrees_of_freedom_spec, authorization_category NONE) with only link_data.link changed; dry-run preview checked. First live create was rejected by Meta (code 100/3858504: the 'standard_enhancements' key is deprecated); the original had it as OPT_OUT, so it was dropped and the create retried once -> new creative 28547059748288778, URL read back equal to 'new' byte for byte. NOT ATTACHED: the original stores no link_data.name; its headline was scraped from the link ('title' = 'راوي الدرعية'). Meta scraped the new link (t.co + query params) and derived title='t.co', so attaching would change the ad's visible headline (a text change the rules forbid). A third create (e.g. with link_data.name='راوي الدرعية' set explicitly) would exceed the retry limit, so the ad was left on its old creative: re-read shows creative 120203212129110598, link unchanged, ACTIVE/ACTIVE. Needs the user's decision. Also note that t.co short links may not pass appended query params on to the destination, and Meta's scraper could not resolve the t.co+UTM link to the old page title.
